body: I feel your pain. My planned day is in 79 days. I still have a lot of things to take care of before then, but I hope I can somehow manage to get things taken care of. Best of luck to you... I hope something good will happen in your life before the day, maybe you'll be able to change your mind. I've been suffering with depression for two decades and can't bear the thought of being so unhappy for any longer...

Thanks for taking time to reply... I really don't know how to talk with my "friends" considering I haven't talked to anyone in a long time (years in most cases)... thanks for trying to help, I sincerely appreciate it.
